thread:
Rosa: Heads up: since ~11:07 UTC eu-west1c is seeing a backlog of tiny-gpu pods in Pending and a correlated rise in attach-service errors (deadline exceeded / ECONNRESET). Noticed a jump in preemptions as scheduler tries to free contiguous slots.
Ben: Is this localized to a subset of racks or widespread?
Rosa: Concentrated: rack-3 and rack-4 in eu-west1c. Logs show binding stalls: 'failed to bind: attach timeout' then immediate eviction events.
Yusuf: We pushed node-tainting policy 'gpu.workload-load=high:NoSchedule' during the taint-rollout yesterday. Could cause packing fragmentation if combined with small pod footprints.
Kai: Also seeing conntrack count spike on kube-proxy on the affected nodes, might be impairing attach traffic to attach-service.
Ben: Quick mitigation ideas: (A) increase tiny warmpool in region; (B) relax taint enforcement for tiny workloads; (C) add attach-route fallback to eu-west1b; (D) enable temporary softAffinity for tiny pods. Prefer A + C to minimize policy churn.
Rosa: Plan: warmpool +12 in eu-west1c, add attach-service routing fallback to eu-west1b on high latency, canary softAffinity 15% for label 'gpu-tier=tiny'. I'll run the commands.
ops-bot: running preflight checks...
ops-bot: preflight: warmpool quota ok for +12, no active scheduler config rollout, eu-west1b attach-service healthy.
Rosa: Scaling warmpool: `warmpoolctl scale --region eu-west1c --pool tiny-gpu --delta +12`
Rosa: Applying scheduler canary (15%):
```
kubectl -n kube-system patch configmap sched-policy --patch 'data:{"softAffinityCanary":"{\"selector\":{\"labels\":{\"gpu-tier\":\"tiny\"}},\"percent\":15}'}'
```
Ben: Adding attach fallback rule in envoy layer: route attach-service.eu-west1c -> attach-service.eu-west1b when latency > 8s. This should reduce immediate ECONNRESET spikes.
Yusuf: Monitor windows: 0-15m: pending tiny-gpu, preempt/sec, attach latency; 15-60m: cross-AZ egress, packing spill. Alert if pending > 250 or preempt/sec > 60 for 5m.
Kai: Also running a light packing simulator off prod topology to ensure we don't cause larger cross-az packing that inflates egress.
Rosa: Warmpool scale executed and succeeded. Canary applied. Early signs: pending count down ~30% on canary nodes. attach latency in eu-west1c still elevated but envoy fallback is routing ~22% of calls to eu-west1b.
Ben: Cost watch: infra-costs alert shows small spike due to on-demand fallbacks earlier; keep an eye on instance upsizing.
Yusuf: If canary stable at 30m, ramp softAffinity to 100% for region and mark taint-rollout as deferred for tiny-gpu class. Rollback plan: remove canary + scale warmpool down if regressions. Ticket created ENGPLAT-2142.
Rosa: Noted. Will post updates. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
